dataset_requirement: Same tcn_v3_eval synthetic dataset (~506k events) for all methods within each seed; all methods share the same dataset fingerprint per seed.
methodology_cautions: The six reference methods are common-data adaptations, not exact reproductions on their original paper datasets.
Fig.4 detection latency (event trigger to decision in ms) is not available from current batch adapters and is not fabricated.
Fig.4 time-to-detect uses attack-instance first event to first test event score above a nominal-validation threshold.
Fig.5 currently evaluates collusion-labeled events/members with validation-only thresholding; it is not a group-level metric for methods without native group outputs.
Fig.6 and Fig.7 require measurements from actual component-level load and ablation runs; blank templates are provided rather than synthetic result values.
--quick outputs are engineering smoke tests and must not be reported as research results.
